questions.question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

**You have made a mistake in writing your answer.**

options.text: A mistake have been made by you in writing your answer.
A mistake has been made by you in writing your answer.
A mistake is being made by you in writing your answer.
A mistake had been made by you in writing your answer.

questions.solution:
**The correct answer is option 2.**

The tense here is **Present Perfect Tense.**

**Active voice- Subject + Have/has + v3 + object + other word.**

**Passive voice- Object + Have/has + been + v3 +By + subject + other word.**

The structure will be followed by the given sentence.

Passive structure of this sentence is followed only by option 2.

So, this will be the right choice as the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

Hemant said to the hotel receptionist, "Please tell Bharat I will come to see him tomorrow at 10 am."

options.text: Hemant requested the hotel receptionist to inform Bharat that he would come to see him the next day at 10 am.
Hemant requested to the hotel receptionist please inform Bharat I will come to see him tomorrow at 10 am.
Hemant said to the hotel receptionist to please tell Bharat that I will come to see him tomorrow at 10 am.
Hemant said to the hotel receptionist please to tell Bharat he will come to see me tomorrow at 10 am.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 1.

We need to change Please Into Requested that is done only in option 1 & 2.

We need to change will into Would and this is done in the only option 1.

Both conditions are fulfilled by option 1 so, this is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. I should have charged double the amount, but it didn't occur to me then.

B. Now, after all the expenses and the gardener's salary, I made a profit of only five hundred rupees.

C. The jasmine plants flowered twice and I sold 250 grams of buds just for ten rupees.

D. Had I charged at least twenty rupees I would have made a good profit.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 3**.
 
• There is only one independent sentence in the given sentences i.e. C, so sentence C is our first sentence.
 
• Sentence C says that the person sold the jasmine flowers for some rupees later he feels he should have sold it for more amount which is in sentence A.
 
• Sentence D is the continuation of sentence A that if he had sold it for more mount he would have made a good profit.
 
• His overall profit is said in sentence B which is the last sentence.
 
• **Therefore, option 3 CADB is the correct answer.**

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.

A. Gone are the days when you stayed with one firm for your entire career and made lifelong friends in the office.

B. This phenomenon was noted in a recent research report which found that the median tenure for employees below the age of 30 is just two years.

C. The research report stated that young people today are tempted to switch jobs quickly.

D. As job longevity becomes a phenomenon of the past, there is a change in attitude in the modern generation towards employment.
questions.solution:
• **The correct answer is Option 2 DBCA.**
 
• Option 1 gets eliminated because the sentence B is beginning with a determiner.
 
• Sentence D is the first sentence as it is an independent sentence which is talking about a phenomenon of the job longevity.
 
• This is continued in sentence B which says that this phenomenon was noted in a recent research report.
 
• Sentence C talks about what the research report stated so C is the third sentence. The only remaining sentence i.e. A is our last sentence.
 
• **Therefore, this sequence is followed in Option 2**
